crossRefs.note: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds…
From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come…

translations.web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
translations.bsb: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
